objectives: Explain why Joseph's evil report was law, not tale bearing.
Interpret Joseph's dreams and how they were fulfilled.
Explain how envy and hatred led the brothers to sell Joseph.
takeaways: A witness that does not utter what he has seen bears his iniquity (Leviticus 5:1); Joseph kept the law.
The vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another (Ecclesiasticus 34:3); the sun, moon and twelve stars figure Israel (Revelation 12:1).
Envy has no fellowship with wisdom; whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer (1 John 3:15).
Joseph was sold to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver and brought into Egypt.
Ye thought evil against me, but God meant it unto good, to save much people alive (Genesis 50:20).
